model: Bulk mean NaCl lattice with equal reference counts Nof regular Na and Cl sites. Schottky pair fraction s removes s*NNa atoms and s*NCl atoms from the specimen. Additional Na Frenkel fraction f transfers f*NNa atoms from regular Na sites into allowed interstitial sites,conserving specimen atoms and mass. No other mass change,substitution or defect species is allowed. Thus regular Na-vacancy fraction is s+f,Cl-vacancy fraction is s,and Na-interstitial count per reference regular Na site is f. The stated interval bounds f;no measured interstitial occupancy is supplied. Fractions refer to reference sites,not the remaining occupied sites. The measured volume ratio is independent data,not inferred from defect count.
target: Return reference mass density in g/cm^3,the identified Schottky pair fraction,the sharp allowed f interval and sharp regular Na-vacancy-fraction interval. Report whether Frenkel-only defects can reproduce the measured mass-density AND volume ratios,and whether the data identify the total point-defect population. Treat noninteger per-cell averages as bulk mean occupancies.

provenance.kind: Explicit controlled conditional material model;not a measured material claim.
